task.ques: Find the names of people in ArXiv's Leadership Team.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: arXiv’s Leadership Team consists of Penelope Lewis (Chief Executive Officer), Jeff Sank (Engineering Director), Stephanie Orphan (Program Director), and Steinn Sigurdsson (Scientific Director).

Source: arXiv’s official “Leadership Team” page, https://info.arxiv.org/about/people/leadership_team.html (accessed October 27, 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the Leadership Team heading and all four names and roles.
